title: Pokémon TCG: Litleo - 015/131 - Master Ball - Prismatic Evolutions
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Pokémon TCG: Litleo card from the Scarlet & Violet - Prismatic Evolutions set features the Fire attribute and is part of the Master Ball series. Manufactured by Nintendo, this standard-sized card is made of durable card stock and is perfect for collectors and players aged 6 and up. With a unique Reverse Holo finish and English language text, this Pokémon card showcases Litleo as a character in the popular trading card game.
